text.p: Michelin reported a charge of 845 million francs on its 1996 results that includes a 750 million franc provision for its minority stake in a bank and 1.15 billion in restructuring provisions, the finance director said on Tuesday.

The risk provision "entirely covers" Michelin's exposure linked to its 38 percent holding in Banque Industrielle et Mobiliere Privee, finance director Eric Bourdais de Charbonniere told a news conference.
The restructuring charges include 705 million francs for job cuts in Spain and 310 million francs 735 job cuts in France, including 500 early retirements, he said.
Michelin generated a 964 million franc capital gain from asset sales, due mostly to the sale of a 2.6 percent stake in PSA Peugeot Citroen in December, he said.
